body.text:
Take command of your own valiant fleet😈
 – the galaxy awaits its destined ruler🚴

For over a hundred years, Elara, the elven princess, pursued her knight Kael passionately 🧝‍♀️, only to receive endless indifference and betrayal in return 💔. She witnessed Kael falling head over heels for Mira, his illegitimate half‑sister 😔. What was worse, he pushed her out to take a blade during danger ⚔️. He even ordered her to suffer nine hundred and ninety‑nine moon‑blade tortures just because Mira got hurt 🌙. Her heart completely broken, Elara resolutely cut off all past ties ✂️. Using her agreement to marry the comatose prince of the Winter Realm on Mira’s behalf as her bargaining chip, she took away half of the national treasury together with her loyal clansmen and traveled far to the frozen northern lands ❄️. In the Winter Realm, Elara awakened Prince Caelan, cursed for a hundred years, with her original spiritual power ✨. It turned out that Caelan had fallen in love with her at first sight a century ago, and this marriage contract was originally arranged by him to shelter her 🤍. He healed her wounds with respect and deep affection, granting her genuine freedom and the right to choose 🕊️. When Kael, who came to stop the wedding, confessed the truth that he had mistaken his savior for someone else 🫠, Elara did not turn back. She chose to stand side by side with Caelan and start a brand‑new life amid ice and snow 🏔️.
